title: Packs
description: Optional undercrew choice. Creatures trained to aid, defend, or otherwise benefit the ship in some way.

options.name: Lemur Pack
options.description: A 3-track group of nimble helpers that keep the ship clear of smaller insects.

options.name: Spring-Foxes
options.description: A 3-track pod of foxes that dance and leap through the waves around the ship as it travels.
options.special: Their behaviour can warn of dangers from the deeper canopy.

options.name: A Stretch of Slinks
options.description: A 3-track group of semi-spectral cats, usually found in dockyards and spit-city alleyways.
options.special: Spend most of their time hunting rats and getting into absurdly awkward spaces.

options.name: A Brace of Hounds
options.description: A 3-track pair of dogs, fiercely protective of their ship.
options.special: Offer comfort and the ability to play a great game of fetch.

options.name: Rig-Ferrets
options.description: A 3-track group of ferrets used to tie and untie knots far above deck.

options.name: Whirling Bats
options.description: A 3-track colony that lends an appreciably gothic look to the ship from a distance.

options.name: Frenzy-Parrot
options.description: A 3-track parrot with a shrill and annoying squawk.
options.special: Tolerated as an early warning system for dangerous predators roaming nearby.

options.name: Trained Pinwolf
options.description: A 3-track predator raised from birth to regard the ship as home and the crew as its pack.
options.special: Fights in close combat to defend the ship, dealing CQ Blunt, Keen, or Spike damage.

options.name: Squirrel Flingers
options.description: A 3-track pack of tiny but ferocious squirrels armed with miniature slings.
options.special: Fight at range to defend the ship, dealing LR Blunt, Keen, or Spike damage.

options.name: Geist Octopus
options.description: A 5-track cephalopod with a little bit of everything in one cool package.
options.special: Once per journey, a single crewmember can roll 6d6 in place of their usual dice pool on any task it could conceivably help with.

options.name: Dragon-Tail Butterflies
options.description: A 5-track group of butterflies with beautiful, elongated wings.
options.special: Regarded by many as a good-luck charm.

options.name: Spider Colony
options.description: A 3-track colony, once a tzelicrae, now barely holding it together.
options.special: Keeps insects and rodents away from the ship.

options.name: Glass-Shell Snails
options.description: A 3-track group of snails. Crews with glass-shell snails on board learn to tread lightly, especially at night.

options.name: Scorpion Set
options.description: A 3-track set of surly, patient, and venomous scorpions.
options.special: Often found sunning themselves on railings or hiding inside boots.

options.name: Medical Mosquitoes
options.description: A 3-track annoyance, but a useful one: they carry a symptomless infection that increases resistance to other infections.
options.special: Infections and viruses don't naturally transfer from crewmember to crewmember.

options.name: Glowbug Parade
options.description: A 3-track horde of fireflies that follow crewmembers around decks and corridors.
options.special: Gives all crew members their own dim lantern-like light while on the ship, unless shooed away.

options.name: Mantis Sentries
options.description: A 3-track group of stone-still sentries that let their prey come to them.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal specimen when you dock at port.

options.name: Rust-Roaches
options.description: A 3-track group that feeds off rust and metallic impurities.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal piece of salvage when you dock at port.

options.name: Etterescu
options.description: A 3-track group of lurking centipedes that prefer darker places.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal whisper when you dock at port.

options.name: Library Boatmen
options.description: A 3-track group of spider-like creatures that make homes in discarded paper plucked from the waves.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal chart when you dock at port.
